title: 实现 Asia/Shanghai 每日免费权益纵向链路
objective: 以契约先行方式实现 Core 的 Asia/Shanghai 每日免费权益纵向链路：每个上海自然日三个 Skin creation_session、自然日重置、不累计、并发安全、请求幂等和版本化策略生效期。
in_scope: Contracts 先行收敛 GET /v1/entitlements（credits:read，可加 PAT 替代认证）与 POST /v1/credits/consume（serviceOAuth credits:consume、Idempotency-Key、仅 daily_entitlement 来源、稳定幂等冲突与权益耗尽问题语义）到 0.1.0-alpha.3，如实记录与 alpha.2 的兼容分类
Core entitlement 模块：版本化 EntitlementPolicy（module=skin、operation=creation_session、timezone=Asia/Shanghai、daily grant=3、显式生效期），基线策略经前向只增迁移可审计建立
每日权益状态保存策略快照与 policy_date，(user_id, policy_id, policy_date) 唯一约束防重复授予，已生成权益不被后续策略版本追溯改变
注入时钟按 Asia/Shanghai 计算 policy_date，测试覆盖 UTC 15:59:59/16:00:00 日界线且不依赖机器时区
消费经数据库事务、唯一约束与原子条件更新保证不超发，Redis 锁或进程内互斥不作为正确性依据
持久化幂等命令记录：调用方、操作名、Idempotency-Key、规范化请求指纹、执行状态与最终响应；同键同指纹回放原结果，同键不同指纹稳定冲突
新消费成功时在同一 Core PostgreSQL 事务写审计与 INTERNAL outbox；不发布未进入 Contracts 的跨服务公共事件
读取端支持 OIDC 用户并复用 PAT 主体解析与 credits:read；消费端实现独立服务主体验证边界，不为服务 token 建立 IdentityLink/Profile
更新 Contracts 机器校验脚本、状态页、API 目录、兼容说明与矩阵（生产者验证后）
更新 Core STATUS、开发计划（第 5 步完成、第 6 步下一阶段）与验收证据
out_of_scope: CreditAccount 或 CreditLedgerEntry 业务逻辑、积分发放、签到、贡献奖励、消费、退款或人工调整
免费权益耗尽后的积分自动回退（后续消费编排器工作流）
Skin 消费者、Official Skin 集成、TypeScript SDK、消费者集成
管理员策略管理 API、公开 outbox 发布器、跨服务事件或消息消费者
修改 Community、Skin、Ops 业务文件或 Skin 工作流
硬编码 Q-003、Q-013 或其他未决产品数值
创建远程仓库、推送或部署
contract_impact: prerelease compatible convergence: Core 0.1.0-alpha.3 converges the previously declared-but-unimplemented entitlements and consume skeleton with explicit problem semantics, PAT alternative authentication on GET, and a daily_entitlement-only source enum; all 0.1.0-alpha.2 locked surfaces keep their semantics unchanged
acceptance_evidence: Contracts Python and Redocly validation pass with evolved 0.1.0-alpha.3 machine gates
Core format, lint, typecheck, unit, integration, end-to-end, architecture, migration, contract and build validations pass, plus the runtime image build
Twelve-way concurrent first consumption materializes exactly one daily entitlement and never over-issues beyond three units per Asia/Shanghai day
Same-key same-fingerprint replays return the original result with one audit and one internal outbox effect; same-key different-fingerprint returns a stable conflict
The Shanghai day boundary is enforced by an injected clock: UTC 15:59:59 belongs to the previous policy date and UTC 16:00:00 to the next; new days restore three units without carryover
Policy version switching only affects entitlements whose effective time starts afterwards; already-materialized daily entitlements keep their snapshots
Non-ACTIVE accounts, unverified identities, insufficient scopes, expired or revoked PATs and illegal service principals are all rejected
GET /v1/entitlements returns values validated against the locked entitlement JSON Schema and never consumes quota
